description: This header file provides helper functions and enums for identifying file formats (such as Flatbuffer and ZIP) when reading serialized data in the PyTorch JIT mobile context. It includes functions for detecting file types based on magic headers, reading file contents, and handling errors.

methods.name: getFileFormat
methods.description: Determines the file format based on magic header bytes in a character buffer.

methods.name: getFileFormat
methods.description: Determines the file format based on magic header bytes read from an input stream.

methods.name: getFileFormat
methods.description: Determines the file format based on the magic header bytes of a file given its filename.

methods.name: file_not_found_error
methods.description: Handles error when a file cannot be opened, providing an error message.

methods.name: get_file_content
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into memory, using mmap if available.

methods.name: get_stream_content
methods.description: Reads the entire content of an input stream into memory.

methods.name: get_rai_content
methods.description: Reads data from a caffe2::serialize::ReadAdapterInterface into memory.
